analysis.summary: Akiko Global Services Limited held its Q1 FY27 earnings conference call on July 31, 2026. The company reported revenue of INR 68 crore for Q1 FY27, driven by branch expansion and offline scaling. Management revised its FY27 revenue guidance upwards to INR 325 crore - INR 350 crore and targeted a PAT margin of 9% to 11%. Additionally, development of its fintech application, AkikoPay, is complete with plans to integrate insurance and mutual fund distribution within 40 to 45 days. Akiko Global Services Limited presented its Q1 FY27 investor presentation detailing its financial and operational performance.

guidance.claim: Management revised its revenue guidance for FY27 to between INR 325 crores and INR 350 crores.
guidance.quote: I am very comfortable to get INR325 crores to INR350 crores this FY27.

guidance.claim: Management expects a PAT margin of 9% to 11% for the current financial year.
guidance.quote: Sir, I am confident of 9% to 11% for this year.

guidance.claim: Management expects PAT margins to increase to 12% to 14% next year if AkikoPay performs well.
guidance.quote: If AkikoPay works very well, next year that will go up to 12% to 14%.

guidance.claim: Management expects revenue CAGR to remain at 70% to 100% year-on-year over the next three years.
guidance.quote: Because my vision is very clear for the next 3 years that our CAGR will remain the same at 70% to 100% year-on-year basis.

guidance.claim: The company targets reaching around INR 1,000 crores in loan disbursements by December end.
guidance.quote: Sir, our vision is that in this quarter, our employee count should reach 1,400 to 1,500, plus by December end, we will reach around INR1,000 crores disbursement.

guidance.claim: Management remains confident of achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of ₹300–325 crore with healthy profitability.
guidance.quote: Management remains confident of achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of ₹300–325 crore with healthy profitability, supported by continued operational execution, growing contribution from digital initiatives, and the evolution of Akiko into a scalable consumer fintech platform.

guidance.claim: Management expects FY27 revenue growth of 70% to 100% with a minimum target of INR 300 crores.
guidance.quote: I would like to give an outlook for FY27, which approximately I am expecting a target of 70% to 100% revenue growth, we have taken a minimum.

guidance.claim: Profit margins are expected to remain within similar profitability levels of 9% to 11%.
guidance.quote: And profit margins will also remain with similar profitability.

guidance.claim: The company maintains a long-term vision to reach INR 1,000 crores in revenue by 2030 with PAT margins of 12% to 13%.
guidance.quote: We have a proper clear vision that we build INR1,000 crores revenue by 2030 and take PAT margins further to 12% to 13%.

guidance.claim: For Q1, management expects revenue around INR 65 crores to INR 70 crores.
guidance.quote: I am expecting INR65 crores to something in between crores in Q1.

guidance.claim: Management targets AkikoPay revenue of INR 50 crores to INR 100 crores in FY27.
guidance.quote: If seen, I am expecting AkikoPay revenue of INR50 crores to INR100 crores in FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: The company receives a daily average of 200 to 300 leads for loans and credit cards on AkikoPay.
demand_outlook.quote: On AkikoPay, credit leads coming in such as for loans and credit cards, if I look at the daily average, we are getting 200 to 300 leads.

demand_outlook.claim: Personal loans are currently the fastest-growing loan product for the company.
Credit card penetration in India remains relatively low at ~7-8% of the population.
demand_outlook.quote: Credit card penetration remains relatively low at ~7-8% of the population, indicating significant headroom for expansion compared to global benchmarks.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that physical branch presence increases lead conversion rates from 10% to between 60% and 80%.
demand_outlook.quote: Where our digital conversion rate is 10%, with physical presence, that conversion reaches 60% to 80%, which we have felt over the last two years.

demand_outlook.claim: The initial response to AkikoPay has been encouraging, with over 57,000 downloads and healthy user engagement trends.
demand_outlook.quote: The initial response to AkikoPay has been very encouraging. So far, we have done some 50,000+ Android downloads, and we have negligible cost on that. And user engagement trends are also very healthy.

demand_outlook.claim: Dubai operations have begun reviving from April onwards after facing temporary pressure due to geopolitical situations around the Iran region.
demand_outlook.quote: And, it has started reviving again from April onwards.

capex_expansion.claim: The company recently added branches in Kolkata, UP, and Hyderabad, with plans for upcoming branches in Indore and Kerala.
capex_expansion.quote: This year we recently added a Kolkata branch, two branches in UP, one more branch in Hyderabad, and currently these are the ones.

capex_expansion.claim: All of the company's operating branches are on rent or lease.
capex_expansion.quote: All are on rent/lease. None are owned.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expanded its company-owned branch presence to 16 branches across multiple cities in India.
capex_expansion.quote: I mean, where we had three or four branches in the last quarter, today we have 16 branches across India.

capex_expansion.claim: Total combined workforce, including employees and channel partners, has crossed 900+.
capex_expansion.quote: Reflecting this scale-up, our total combined workforce, including employees and channel partners, has now crossed 900+, which is a very strong growth compared to last year.

margins_costs.claim: The company earns an average payout of 3.10% in its unsecured loan business.
margins_costs.quote: In unsecured, our average payout itself is 3.10%.

margins_costs.claim: The company generates additional monthly revenue of INR 1 crore to INR 1.25 crores from its three subsidiaries.
margins_costs.quote: Apart from INR21 crores, from our three subsidiaries, we get an additional revenue of INR1 crores to INR1.25 crores.

margins_costs.claim: The company's core offline distribution business grows by 4% to 7% month-on-month.
margins_costs.quote: because our offline business, our core business, and our distribution are increasing month-on-month by 4% to 7%.

margins_costs.claim: AkikoPay achieves approximately 40% lower customer acquisition costs compared to traditional channels.
margins_costs.quote: ~40% lower CAC vs traditional channels, enabled by a lean, digital-first model

margins_costs.claim: The platform operates on a disciplined cost structure with controlled operating burn.
margins_costs.quote: Disciplined cost structure with controlled operating burn

margins_costs.claim: AkikoPay has a negligible customer acquisition cost model as downloads are driven through cross-sell channels and the existing database.
margins_costs.quote: There's no expense, that is completely negligible led model. I mean, even all AkikoPay application downloading is through our cross-sell channel. We are not burning any single penny on AkikoPay because we have made a huge empire, we have 1,500 employees, we have a database of 25 million, so we are going to monetize that.

orders_capacity.claim: The company possesses a customer database of 25 million.
orders_capacity.quote: we have a database of 25 million.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's headcount includes 16 employees on tech, around 700 in sales, and 50 in backend operations.
orders_capacity.quote: Look, currently on the tech side, we have a total of 16 people -- 16 people on the tech side. On the sales side, we have odd 700 people. On the backend side, we have odd 50 people.

orders_capacity.claim: The company aims to increase total employee headcount to 1,400 to 1,500.
orders_capacity.quote: Sir, our vision is that in this quarter, our employee count should reach 1,400 to 1,500, plus by December end, we will reach around INR1,000 crores disbursement.

orders_capacity.claim: Monthly loan disbursals increased to over ₹450 crore while monthly credit card sourcing scaled to 17,000–18,000 cards during Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Operational execution remained strong during the quarter, with monthly loan disbursals increasing to over ₹450 crore, while monthly credit card sourcing scaled to 17,000–18,000 cards, driven by the Company's expanding distribution capabilities, technology-enabled customer acquisition platform, and deep banking and NBFC partnerships.

orders_capacity.claim: The monthly loan disbursement run rate has reached INR 400 crores+, translating to an annual book of INR 5,000 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Currently, we have reached a monthly disbursement run rate of INR400 crores+, which if we count annually, our book has become INR5,000 crores as of today.

capital_allocation.claim: Receivable days dropped from 133 to 110 days and are expected to reach within 90 days in Q2.
capital_allocation.quote: From 133 days, receivable days are coming down to 110 days. In Q2, I see receivable days coming down to within 90 days.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has no fundraising plans for the next 6 months to 1 year due to aligned cash credit limits.
capital_allocation.quote: So, our CC limits are well aligned. So, no need for any fundraising for the next 6 months or 1 year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Quarterly revenue from the Dubai business was restricted to INR 1.25 crores due to war conditions.
risks_headwinds.quote: In Dubai, due to war, our total revenue for the entire quarter was INR1.25 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: Margin pressure in Q4 was impacted by temporary geopolitical issues around the Iran region affecting Dubai operations.
risks_headwinds.quote: And some of our margin pressure has come in Dubai operations, there has been temporary margin pressure due to the current geopolitical situation, as you all know, around the Iran region.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets reaching an employee count of 1,400 to 1,500 and monthly disbursements of INR 1,000 crores by December end.
management_commitments.quote: Sir, our vision is that in this quarter, our employee count should reach 1,400 to 1,500, plus by December end, we will reach around INR1,000 crores disbursement.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to achieve FY27 revenue of INR 325 crores to INR 350 crores.
management_commitments.quote: I am very comfortable to get INR325 crores to INR350 crores this FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to maintain a CAGR of 70% to 100% over the next 3 years.
management_commitments.quote: Because my vision is very clear for the next 3 years that our CAGR will remain the same at 70% to 100% year-on-year basis.

management_commitments.claim: The integration of insurance and mutual funds on AkikoPay is scheduled to take 40 to 45 days.
management_commitments.quote: From here, integration will take about 40 days -- 45 days.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to achieve revenue guidance of ₹300–325 crore in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Management remains confident of achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of ₹300–325 crore with healthy profitability, supported by continued operational execution, growing contribution from digital initiatives, and the evolution of Akiko into a scalable consumer fintech platform.

management_commitments.claim: The iOS version of AkikoPay is expected to offer a comprehensive user experience in the coming months.
management_commitments.quote: The iOS version is progressing as planned and is expected to offer a similar comprehensive experience in the coming months.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that AkikoPay will be live on iOS within this month with all features.
management_commitments.quote: So most likely within this month, AkikoPay will be live on iOS with all features.

management_commitments.claim: Management committed that Ankur Gaba will take the MD or CEO position in the next quarter.
management_commitments.quote: So, we'll take a -- we'll take a decision very soon and in the next quarter, you will see me as an MD.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to scale the unsecured loan book to INR 1,000 crores by March 31st.
management_commitments.quote: By FY27, my target is INR1,000 crores of unsecured book. So, the INR400 crores is to be taken to INR1,000 crores. This is my complete vision, complete target till 31st March.

management_commitments.claim: Mutual fund and insurance products are expected to go live by August.
management_commitments.quote: So mutual fund and insurance going to be live by August onwards because for that I have applied for some IRDAI license.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
